name: Yoga school in Athens
reason: No school's own website found in three searches (English and Greek). Results were almost all directories and booking platforms (BookRetreats, Retreat Guru, BalanceBoat, Greeka) and travel blogs; trainings listed were mostly on islands or elsewhere in Greece (Evia, Sparta, Mytikas, Ioannina, Crete), several framed as therapeutic. 'Athens Yoga' (central studio since 2008) appeared only on Greeka, with no own domain found; domains are never guessed.
